"intelligence" as used in common speech means readiness in learning,
quickness of mind. Its higher Gospel meaning is more profound. The
intelligent man is he who seeks knowledge and uses it in accordance with
the plan of the Lord for human good. This is implied in the revelation from
which the quotation is made, for the full sentence reads, "The glory of God
is intelligence, or, in other words, light and truth." When men follow the
light their knowledge will always be well used. Intelligence, then becomes but another name for wisdom. In the
language of mathematics we may say that knowledge, plus the proper use of
knowledge, equals intelligence or wisdom. In this sense intelligence
becomes the goal of the successful life.
